about_the_game:
Survivors Guild is a survivors-like bullet heaven where you travel to different lands and take on hordes of monsters! Choose your weapons and items wisely to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

Features

1-4 Player Online Co-op

Party up and slay hordes of monsters together with your friends!

Craft the Perfect Build

Collect various items and upgrade your weapons to customize the way you play. Lowly common or coveted rare, each item provides important buffs or abilities!

Complete Quests

Finish different objectives within each level to unlock extra rewards. Smash pots, deliver important items, defeat rare monsters, and more!

Travel to Distant Lands

Fight monsters across different landscapes. Travel to grasslands, deserts, or even the fiery depths. Each level is home to different monsters and hazards.

Battle Bosses

A boss monster lurks at the end of each level. Each boss has a unique fighting style and provides different challenges.
